name: Banh xeo gao lut
summary: Brown-rice bánh xèo is red rice ground and cooked on a mold. The Quang Binh visitor portal’s 13 June 2025 article calls the Gia Hưng cake a Phong Nha specialty. Its 2014 and 2024 articles place the cake in Quảng Hòa.
origin: Quảng Hòa in the portal’s 25 September 2014 and 29 May 2024 articles, and Gia Hưng in the portal’s 13 June 2025 Phong Nha article. Both accounts stay.
texture: The 13 June 2025 article says the cake is red-brown from brown rice. The 25 September 2014 article says it is best as soon as it leaves the mold, still hot, with the smell of the rice.
howToEat: The 25 September 2014 article uses red lúa mành, also called gạo lứt, soaked about five hours and ground twice with the soaking water. Salt and chopped chives go into the batter. The cake is rolled with herbs, a salad of red-bean sprouts, rau két, and sesame, banana cá chuối, and bánh đa, then dipped.
Cá chuối in that article is seeded banana, not fish. The fruit is peeled, soaked in alum or lime, sliced, boiled, and shaped.
The 29 May 2024 article lists herbs, nộm, cá chuối, and nước chấm, and it prints bánh đá where the 2014 article prints bánh đa.
The 13 June 2025 article names bánh xèo gạo lứt Gia Hưng and the red-brown color, and it does not describe the roll. A door, an hour, and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Quảng Hòa, in the 2014 and 29 May 2024 articles. The 13 June 2025 article calls it a Phong Nha specialty and does not give a street. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh xeo gao lut — Gia Hung and Quang Hoa
seoDescription: Brown-rice bánh xèo is the Gia Hưng cake in a 2025 Phong Nha article and a Quảng Hòa cake in 2014 and 2024. A price is Check on arrival.
